message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Li (parent) knows his son Li Jr (already convicted) is wanted, helps him escape by giving 400 yuan, then shelters him at home, provides food, lodging, and later false name for medical treatment to avoid police. This is classic "窝藏罪" i.e., harboring a criminal (concealing a criminal). In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "窝藏、包庇罪" (concealing, harboring). The examples: earlier similar case: "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" etc. For harboring, they used "窝藏罪" or "窝藏、包庇罪". In the example for "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得罪" they gave both terms separated by comma? Actually they gave "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". For "强制猥亵、侮辱妇女". So they separate with semicolon for multiple distinct crimes. For single crime, just one term.

Thus answer: [罪名]窝藏罪<eoa> or maybe "窝藏、包庇罪". The text says "应当以窝藏罪追究其刑事责任". So use exactly "窝藏罪". So final answer.
